bookkeeping.rowText: Astra, 21 minutes, the three E4 vehicle maps, two honest attempts each, zero errors on every row, no new proof and no defect: the Dust Flats (F-PP3-1: the Hauler delivered at 43.9 s, deaths at waves 2 and 4, the Land-Yacht unreached), Gusher County (F-PP3-2: the phone completed all three deliveries by 94.4 s then died funding its first defence; desktop missed the north dispatch, wave 14), the Boneyard (F-PP3-3: the phone stopped 1.112 units from the road head, inside the objective's 2.5-unit radius but outside the driver's walking tolerance; a general driver fix). The driver grew the vehicle verbs; the Incline proof re-ran green. YIELD (F-PP3-4): eleven maps, one proof, one partial, one defect, eight holds. Run 4 opens with a CONTROL on the Claim (a proven map): the driver's own verdict before the E8 to E10 maps. Engine hash unchanged {PIN}; no deploy.
